title: Lower
author: Keane M.
desc: Transform your lower body with this focused one-week program designed for beginners. You'll hit all the major muscle groups in your legs, including calves, quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes, using a variety of machines for optimal muscle engagement. Each session includes targeted exercises like the Hack Squat and Leg Press, ensuring you build strength and definition effectively. Perfect for those ready to elevate their training routine in just one day a week!
